title: Widening a timestamp to nanoseconds raises outside 64 bits
description: A cast from microseconds to nanoseconds multiplies by 1000 and raises (`InvalidOperationError`) when the count leaves 64 bits: counts -9223372036854775 and 9223372036854775 give -9223372036854775000 and 9223372036854775000, one past either end raises. The streaming engine agrees.
reference: D61: a cast from microseconds to nanoseconds raises `overflow` when the result leaves 64 bits.

evidence.observed: ok, ERR InvalidOperationError, ok, ERR InvalidOperationError

provenance.notes: Probed at both ends and one past each.
